test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

‘M & N’ means ‘M is the wife of N’

‘M @ N’ means ‘M is the paternal grandfather of N’,

‘M % N’ means ‘M is the brother of N’,

‘M # N’ means ‘M is the son of N’

Based on the above, how is P related to T if ‘P @ Q # R & S % T’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 
 M is

Given: P @ Q # R & S % T

P @ Q → P is the parental grandfather of Q.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd5402c045f5f56315bc761a8f1cb50865f9ff810d3122eae29ebadfc754d89f.png] 

Q # R → Q is the son of R.

R & S → R is the wife of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/733ee8f0df29ffeb26ca71f11f9166c47f6cd9e841eaeee1a4765cb65b8666fd.png] 

S % T → S is the brother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29b7d94c27d8a73a823a4475c9055b0e0d932ae21bcacd5c3a330fcf43a2fd96.png] 

Thus, P is the father of T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
